name: chaos_return_rescue
description: Safety net for chaos_return. Conductor starts it automatically (failureWorkflow) when a return fails or times out, and the backend starts it when a return was terminated by hand. It skips the pointless checks and goes straight to chaos_return_verdict; if even that fails, the return is denied by default, so the case is never left undecided.

inputParameters.queryExpression: def text($d): if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:120] else $d end; if (.verdict | type) == "object" and (.verdict.decision | type) == "string" then .verdict else {decision: "DENIED", approved: false, code: "PAPERWORK_FIRE", amountCents: 0, reference: "DN-FIRE", headline: "Return denied by default", detail: "The returns process and its backup both caught fire, so nothing about this return could be verified and no money can move.", returnId: (.returnId | text("RT-UNNUMBERED")), orderId: (.orderId | text("")), sku: (.sku | text("")), itemName: "an item we cannot identify", qty: 0, reason: "other"} end
